x: For the first time Metropolitan W.C. sent a strong team for this race and Hawkins, Hutchison and Nigel Thompson battled for the first three placings the whole way, eventually finishing in that order.
Metropolitan succeeded in taking fourth individual place with Nigel Thompson, thus having three men in the first four, but adequate backing for them was missing.

Don Thompson soon disappeared into the distance leaving Nigel Thompson of the Met. disputing 2nd place with our own Ken Bailey. Unfortunately Ken was to pay the price for an early fast pace, but he did carry off the handicap by some six minutes.
2. · Met. W.C.(Thomson 2 Thompson D.3 Thompson N. 17 Higgins 31) · 53 points
He finished third in the National 20 Miles, second in the Leicester Mercury 20 miles and second in the National 50 Kms when he split the two Thompson brothers, Don and Nigel.
